beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You sit down in the park with your coffee. Beside the bench, Peter searches his own backpack. A spare battery comes out, then a folded jacket.
beats.chinese: 你拿着咖啡在公园坐下。长椅旁，Peter正在翻自己的背包，先掏出备用电池，又拿出一件折好的外套。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Tissues. I know I packed some. Apparently I packed two kinds of weather as well.
beats.chinese: 纸巾。我记得带了。看样子还把两种天气一起装进去了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He finds a small packet in a side pocket and holds it up with a smile.
beats.chinese: 他从侧袋找到一小包纸巾，笑着举起来。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: There they are. I could have tried that pocket first.
beats.chinese: 找到了。我本来可以先找这个口袋。

choices.english: Ask whether carrying all that gets heavy.
Ask whether he has found what he needed.
choices.chinese: 问他是不是已经找到了。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It does. I like having things ready, but my shoulders have an opinion about that.
beats.chinese: 会。我喜欢准备齐全，不过肩膀对此有不同意见。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He puts the battery into a small case inside the bag.
beats.chinese: 他把电池放回包里的小盒子。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Half of it comes home unused. Not that I mind every time. I just notice it on the longer walks.
beats.chinese: 一半东西都原样带回家。也不是每次都介意，只是走得远时就有感觉了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He folds the jacket smaller before putting it away.
beats.chinese: 他把外套折小一点，再放回去。

choices.english: Ask whether he might bring less next time.
choices.chinese: 问下次会不会少带一点。

choices.english: Ask whether friends often borrow things from him.
choices.chinese: 问朋友是不是常向他借东西。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Yes, all sorted. Just wanted to wipe my own hands.
beats.chinese: 是的，找到了。只是想擦擦自己的手。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He takes one tissue and closes the packet.
beats.chinese: 他抽出一张纸巾，把小包合好。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Now I can put my little shop back in its bag.
beats.chinese: 现在可以把我的小杂货铺收回包里了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He clears his things from the end of the bench.
beats.chinese: 他把长椅一端自己的东西收好。

choices.english: Say you do not need to borrow anything.
choices.chinese: 说明自己不需要借东西。

choices.english: Ask which item he actually uses most.

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Probably that second packet of batteries. I have a spare already. A spare spare may be too much.
beats.chinese: 大概可以少带第二包电池。我已经有备用的了，备用的备用也许有点多。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He checks the two small cases, then puts both back for the journey home.
beats.chinese: 他确认了一下两个小盒子，再把它们都收好带回家。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: I'll leave one at home next time. The jacket stays, though. I do use that.
beats.chinese: 下次留一包在家。不过外套还得带，我真用得上。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the backpack and sits beside it, letting his shoulders rest.
beats.chinese: 他合上背包，在旁边坐下，让肩膀歇一会儿。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Often enough. Someone forgets a light or a jacket, and I am the first person they ask.
beats.chinese: 挺常的。有人忘了带灯或者外套，第一个就来问我。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He rests a hand on the closed bag.
beats.chinese: 他把手搭在合好的包上。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Usually I'm happy to help. But sometimes I need what I've got. I can say that, too.
beats.chinese: 通常我愿意帮忙。不过有时自己的也要用，这个我也可以直说。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He gives an easy smile and settles back without offering you an unwanted item.
beats.chinese: 他轻松地笑了笑，靠着椅背坐稳，没有硬塞东西给你。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: All right. Nothing you need to take, then.
beats.chinese: 好，那就不用拿什么。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He slips the tissue packet into the side pocket where he found it.
beats.chinese: 他把纸巾放回刚才找到它的侧袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: That is where those belong. I may remember it by the next stop.
beats.chinese: 它们原来该放这儿。到下一次歇脚时，我也许就记住了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He laughs quietly and leaves the space beside your coffee clear.
beats.chinese: 他轻轻笑了，给你咖啡旁留出空位。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: The thin jacket. More than the clever bits, honestly.
beats.chinese: 那件薄外套。说真的，比那些小工具常用。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pats the folded jacket near the top of the bag.
beats.chinese: 他拍了拍放在包上层的折好外套。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: It does one simple job. And I can find it without unloading everything. Usually.
beats.chinese: 用途很简单，而且不用把包倒空就找得到。通常是这样。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He pulls the zip closed and gives himself a small, amused shake of the head.
beats.chinese: 他拉好拉链，觉得好笑似的轻轻摇了摇头。

summaryZh: Peter找纸巾时先掏出电池与外套，展示准备过头的普通摩擦。用户可问负担与借用，或让他收好东西、聊最常用的外套；他愿意帮忙也能说自己不够，不强送、不记人情债。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: You sit in the park with a coffee. Peter is checking the switch on his own small torch, keeping it pointed at his bag.
beats.chinese: 你拿着咖啡在公园坐下。Peter正检查自己的小手电开关，始终朝着包里。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: Hello again. Just making sure this is off before I pack it.
beats.chinese: 又见面了。收起来前，先确认它关好了。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He turns the switch off and puts the torch into a side pocket.
beats.chinese: 他关掉开关，把手电放进侧袋。

beats.speaker: npc
beats.english: No work for it now. It can save its batteries.
beats.chinese: 现在不用它干活，先省点电。

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.english: He closes the pocket and sits back for his own break.
beats.chinese: 他合好口袋，靠着椅背歇下来。
